title: Completed proper/open normalization for the integral compact-support compositor
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes and separated finite-type arrows $X\xrightarrow{f}Y\xrightarrow{g}Z$ of finite-type schemes over a field $k$ in which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties; def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the completed ringed derived categories, exact open extension and proper direct image of [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison], and the recorded integral compact-support functors and their projection-normalized realizations of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. For a proper/open cartesian square, define $\lambda$ to be restriction exchange followed by the inverse open unit, and $\Gamma$ its inverse open adjunct. For a compatible compactification tower, define its composition arrow by outer proper pushforward of $\Gamma$, proper composition, and open composition. Define a normalized refinement isomorphism by the open adjunct equation whose transpose is the open unit, and by inverse proper composition followed by pushforward of the inverse adjunct. For arbitrary compactifications $c_f,c_g,c_{gf}$, the predicate $\mathsf{SfIntegralCompositionSpec}(\alpha)$ says: for every compatible tower refining these choices and every integral constructible $K$, the open unit and $\lambda$ are invertible, there are normalized refinement isomorphisms $\rho_f,\rho_g,\rho_{gf}$, and the underlying component of $\alpha$ equals the tower composition conjugated by these refinements and the fixed qcqs realizations. These are the original definitions moved verbatim out of the field-composition module, with no existence or coherence assertion.
